meanings.note: Abstract masculine noun formed with the productive Slavic suffix '-ость' denoting a quality or state ('guest').

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (root 'казаться'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to refuse', forming an aspectual pair with 'отказываться'.

examples.text: Виктор Петрович, гость отказался от блюда.
